envelope.description: Move the band table into a leaf planner module

body.title: Move the band table into a leaf planner module
body.summary: Create a leaf module in src/analyze/planner that holds the band table and the focused lower bound and imports nothing from the validator or the renderer. Make validate.ts import it and keep SCOPE_BAND exported from validate.ts (re-export) so planner/index.ts, analyze/index.ts and validate.test.ts keep working. No value changes.
acceptanceChecks: SCOPE_BAND values and the halved focused lower bound are identical to today's, shown by the existing 'SCOPE_BAND values match the design doc' test passing unchanged
the leaf module has no import from validate.ts or render-catalog.ts
tsc build and the planner tests pass

tests.name: src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: SCOPE_BAND values match the design doc
src/analyze/planner/__tests__/validate.test.ts: the band module imports nothing from the validator or the renderer
